channel.title: Brazil Procurement HOT
channel.description: Government tenders from Brazil's national procurement portal PNCP across eight categories — health, education, works, transport, food, IT, services and supplies. Titles and one-line summaries are rewritten in our own words, with links to the official notices, updated every 30 minutes.

item.title: Alto Boa Vista (MT) Health & medical procurement · electronic pregão (reverse auction) · closes Dec 3 #012
item.description: A public buyer in Alto Boa Vista (MT) is procuring healthcare goods or services through electronic pregão (reverse auction), with an estimated value of about R$ 420,879.01; proposals close Dec 3, 08:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
